**Plan, not yet applied.**

`buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js:11) returns full rows. `toTable()` in [format.js](src/format.js:14) prints only 4 of 6 fields, by design.

1. Add `--json` parsing in [cli.js](src/cli.js:8)
2. On that flag, `JSON.stringify(buildRows())` instead of `toTable(...)`

One call to make: JSON output could include all fields, or just match the table's 4 columns. "Same data" suggests all fields. Confirm before I write it.
